title: Unit Event — What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child — Episode1 Daily Life "As Usual"

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child
meta.Event Outline: With university practice exams looming, Mafuyu continues to study to meet her mother's expectations. Meanwhile, Mizuki suggests a trip to an amusement park for N25.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The pace of that cram school class was so much faster than usual today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Probably because we're taking a practice exam this weekend... And things likely felt a little different because everyone's making their final preparations.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to get a good score on this practice exam...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
I take it cram school went well? Are you ready for that practice exam?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I should be.
But I'll have to keep studying to make sure I get an A.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You did well on all those other practice exams... But this upcoming one is for specific schools.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: For the sake of your future, an A for Meio University... No, I'm sure you want that for Koto University at the very least, so I understand why you seem so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I promise not to...
I have to keep up with the other students since they've begun making their final preparations, but I'll be mindful of my health.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. And I'm sure you'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to seeing some good results.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mom.
I'll do my best.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If we keep this up, we'll be ready to upload our new song the day after tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Awesome! I put a ton of effort into the video, so I can't wait to see everyone's responses.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hold your horses... Great work? You know we're still not done yet, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. Yeah, I know...
But the quality of our songs has been going up, so I really can't wait to see what people think.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's understandable.
Speaking of which, we still don't have the rough draft for our next song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I'm going to need more time to figure out the concept for this song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So the rough draft is going to take a little longer than usual for me to finish...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Uh... I've been spending some of my free time here and there to come up with something, but I haven't had much luck...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay...
Yeah, we all hit a wall sometimes.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But we're all gonna be making small fixes to our current song through the day after tomorrow, so I feel like there's no rush.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Right. Thank you...
But I still want to finish my draft sooner rather than later...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heh heh heh.
In that case, leave it to moi!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hold on. The way you just said that... You're not planning anything funny, are you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Don't worry!
This trip won't be scary at all!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <This trip? So, we're going somewhere together?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup! I'm actually in possession of one-day passes to Phoenix Wonderland!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's right! One of the cast members that I'm friends with gave them to me and said that I should visit with everyone in my group!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I know, right♪
He builds life-size robots and stuff for his shows... And sometimes performs explosive experiments at school...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. That's because he always goes all out for his shows!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, why don't we all go to PXL together since I have some tickets?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, but they're for a specific date, so we can only go this Sunday...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm all for that. Everyone's been talking about how great the night show is online, so I've been meaning to see it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, that's all the more reason for us to go! And it'll be a nice way for us to relax!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes...
I'm not a fan of crowded places, but I'll go if it can help me compose more songs...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, why not go?
It probably won't be like the mystery tour we went on, but I'm sure you'll find some nice inspiration.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And you'll have plenty of chances to take some good selfies during the night show, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Going to an amusement park with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, Yuki, how about you? Can you go?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to seeing some good results.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I can't. I have to take a practice exam that day...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, a practice exam...?
That's too bad.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Then, PXL's just nearby.
Wanna meet up once you're done?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
We should try to go together since we can!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay, maybe just for a bit after I finish taking my practice exam...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<...!
Sorry, I need to mute myself for a second.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I was watching a movie.
I thought I could work on my English listening skills if I turned the subtitles off.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Ah, that explains why your computer's on. But you don't have to watch it in darkness like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought that it'd be bothersome if light seeped out of my room.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a good girl, Mafuyu. Staying up so late to study like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm sorry for making you worry like this. I promise to go to bed soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Understood.
In that case, good night.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It was my mom telling me to go to bed soon. Anyway, about what we were talking about...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I can't go.
I have to see how I did on the practice exam by checking each question after I finish taking it, so you all go without me.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I guess there isn't much we can do about that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But we can always go back on a day when you're not scheduled to take a practice exam!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, you really should take more time to relax, so don't forget to tell us the next time you're free, okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Try not to work too hard, Yuki...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My mom might come back to check in on me again, so I'll be logging off for now...>
